learning.exam-schedule-subtitle: Schedules are published by provincial radio authorities — here is where to look and what to check
learning.exam-schedule-disclaimer: This site does not publish exam dates or track registration windows. Dates come from your provincial radio authority's announcement. Once you have one, put it into the study plan and the countdown, and work backwards from the exam day.
learning.exam-schedule-crac-what: Question-bank updates plus nationwide exam and licence policy announcements
learning.exam-schedule-province-what: Exam sessions, registration windows, venues and fees for your province
learning.exam-schedule-province-entry: The radio-management or announcements section of your provincial industry and IT department's site; entry points differ, so search for your province plus "operator certificate"
learning.exam-schedule-venue-what: The exact venue, schedule changes, ID and entry requirements
learning.exam-schedule-venue-entry: The contact channel you left at registration, plus your local amateur radio club's account or group
learning.exam-schedule-checklist: What to confirm once you find the announcement
learning.exam-schedule-confirm-class-des: Whether the announcement is for class A, B or C: class B needs a licence held for 6 months, class C a licence showing the sub-30 MHz bands held for 18 months.
learning.exam-schedule-confirm-deadline-: Closing date, ID and photo requirements, payment method; there is no late entry, and missing documents mean no admission on the day.
learning.exam-schedule-confirm-format-de: Computer-based or paper, how many questions and how long; if it differs from this site's mock exam, the announcement wins.
learning.exam-schedule-confirm-venue-des: The address, start time and documents to bring; allow travel time for a venue in another city.
learning.exam-schedule-confirm-result-de: When and how results come out, and how the certificate is collected or mailed.
learning.exam-schedule-next-plan: Put it in the study plan
learning.exam-schedule-next-plan-desc: Set the exam date and class; the page turns the questions left and mistakes due into a daily task list, with one mock exam a day for the last 7 days.
learning.exam-schedule-next-countdown-de: Add the exam day to your countdowns and get a browser notification when it arrives.
learning.exam-schedule-next-mock-desc: Draw questions with the real quotas and time it; the graded result shows your rating and per-topic accuracy, so you know how far you are.
